verdict.rationale: AMD documents a configurable power envelope of 45-120W cTDP and Curve Optimizer voltage offsets, which covers the 'documented power envelopes' part of the story. There is no independent testing of sustained render or export performance, throttling behaviour, or perf-per-watt, and the one community comment on power praises performance while questioning power usage. Missing for 10: independent sustained-load or long-render benchmarks, thermal throttling data, perf-per-watt measurements, and documentation of sustained (vs. boost) behaviour within the cTDP range.
